entities.summary: The Royal Park Theatre is a theatre in central Brussels, Belgium. It is located at 3, rue de la Loi/Wetstraat, on the edge of Brussels Park, facing the Belgian House of Parliament. It is served by Brussels-Central railway station, as well as by the metro stations Parc/Park and Arts-Loi/Kunst-Wet.
